proof:
intro n s Lq Lp fq fp Aq Ap bq bp h z w Fq Fp hq hp hw
  have tq : ∀ a : Fin s → ℝ,
      Lq.symm (Lq z.1+h • ∑ j, a j • Lq (Fq j)) = z.1+h • ∑ j, a j • Fq j := by
    intro a
    apply Lq.injective
    simp
  have tp : ∀ a : Fin s → ℝ,
      Lp.symm (Lp z.2+h • ∑ j, a j • Lp (Fp j)) = z.2+h • ∑ j, a j • Fp j := by
    intro a
    apply Lp.injective
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [tq, tp]
    exact congrArg Lq (hq i)
  · intro i
    rw [tq, tp]
    exact congrArg Lp (hp i)
  · rw [hw]
    simp
